MlxCompilerPipeline.Stage: symbols, types, coercions, layouts, exhaustiveness, errors, comptime
minimal mandatory canonicalization; advanced optimization optional for bootstrap
MlxCompilerPipeline.RuntimeSafety: Safety-enabled lowering emits defined traps for checked integer overflow, invalid shift counts, null optional-pointer unwraps, and out-of-bounds array or slice operations. Disabling runtime safety removes checks that are not inherently enforced by the target instruction set and does not change static semantic validation.
